answer: A glacier-slow reputation thaw resists Sybils: every identity starts near zero earning power and only climbs by accumulating verified useful work over many epochs, so a freshly minted army earns almost nothing. A comet audit streak randomly re-verifies past work at any moment, and any identity that fails loses its entire accumulated standing. To reach the top tier, an agent must also lock an ember bond that burns on fraud. Attackers face months of real work per identity before any payoff, while honest agents keep the reputation they slowly earned.
